comment: SfmD catalyzes the regioselective hydroxylation of 3-methyl-l-tyrosine (3-Me-l-Tyr) to produce 3-hydroxy-5-methyl-l-tyrosine (3-OH-5-Me-l-Tyr). However, it can also hydroxylate L-Tyr.

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 2 merged duplicate entry created by Contributor 2.

reactions.description: Heme-containing peroxygenase; SfmD catalyzes the regioselective hydroxylation of 3-methyl-l-tyrosine (3-Me-l-Tyr) to produce 3-hydroxy-5-methyl-l-tyrosine (3-OH-5-Me-l-Tyr)
Hydroxylating L-Tyr to 3-OH-L-Tyr due to substrate promiscuity
Converts L-Tyr to 3-OH-L-Tyr in the saframycin A pathway.
